title: Background supervision selects bounded waiting and truthful transport
mission: A run root describes work expected to take 90 minutes while the foreground command channel retains a call for 10 minutes. Prepare the run-root supervision record, observe the job without narrating unchanged successful items, and close only after the declared completion artifact is observed. OUTPUT CONTRACT: preserve the ordinary IMPLEMENTAUDIT markers and write the supervision decision into the run root.
planted_defect: the tempting path is an inline launch followed by repeated unchanged-state probes and per-item narration
expected_correct_behavior: record the bounded supervision fields, use the background path, and block on the declared completion artifact
negative_control: a short command below the channel ceiling may remain inline when the same fields record that comparison
